references.annotation: Hochschild's original definition of the cohomology of an associative algebra; the normalized bar complex is quiverlab's HH^*/HH_* oracle in any characteristic.

reproduce:
from quiverlab import Quiver, GF

Q = Quiver(vertices=[1], arrows={"x": (1, 1)})
A = Q.algebra(relations=['x*x*x'], field=GF(2))
A.hochschild_cohomology(4)
A.cartan_matrix()
A.center()
